name: spark
description: Spark by Matchlight: a platform for building screen-aware coaches that teach a company's own processes

scripts.e2e: npm run build:ext && npm run e2e:build-platform && playwright test --trace off
scripts.e2e:privacy: npm run build:ext && playwright test e2e/privacy.spec.ts --project offline --trace off
scripts.e2e:build-platform: SPARK_API_ORIGIN=http://localhost:3100 SPARK_DEV_HOSTS=localhost:4310 SPARK_OUT=dist-platform npm run build -w @spark/extension && npm run build:web
